decision: Do not implement now: parent reports completed be09762 USB-only health interval at 0.122447% CRC rejection. Preserve the earlier 3.706% result; no causality claim from this design.

current_gap.probe: sensorarrayAdsSpiProbePass starts ADC once, then reads steady AA/AINCOM differential conversions at 38400 SPS, SINC1, delay0, INTREF off, AVDD/AVSS reference; independent PGA1 and bypass screen200/confirm800 attempts. Register snapshots every64, RTOS yield every32.
current_gap.runtime: sensorarrayAdsMatrixApplyInputProfile emits MODE2 when needed and SetInputMuxFast when changed/forced; it starts ADC only if stopped, then records DRDY generation after writes and the optional analog guard (current guard0us). Repeated steady RDATA does not exercise this interleaved WREG cadence.

datasheet_evidence.fact: Writes restart only the ADCs marked in the register map; completed grouped writes apply together. It is incorrect to say every register write restarts conversion.
INPMUX address06h is ADC1 restart, Group1. Restart drives DRDY high; conversion holding data are cleared.
STOP1 followed by START1 explicitly restarts a running ADC without a RESET command.

same_value_limit: The examined TI text says writing new data and changing the multiplexer; it does not explicitly distinguish a byte identical to the old value. Therefore repeated WREG AA is a justified command-cadence stressor, but this review does not claim the unchanged write has been proven to restart the physical converter. Driver configurationGeneration increments after a successful write regardless; that software event is not physical restart evidence.

minimal_deferred_candidate.placement: Append a distinct cadence=inpmux_write confirm phase after both existing steady confirms for a candidate; keep steady evidence, fine descending frequency list, actual-IDF-clock check and original 30s absolute deadline/500ms cleanup reserve.
minimal_deferred_candidate.sample_loop: For each of800 attempts in each existing PGA1/bypass profile: call ads126xAdcSetInputMuxFast(ads,0xA,0xA) unconditionally (no matrix cache shortcut); on success capture DRDY generation AFTER WREG; then existing FreshChecked with retryBudget0. Use periodic register snapshot verification rather than inserting an RREG before every sample. Current production runtime analog guard is0us.
minimal_deferred_candidate.unchanged_safety: No matrix route/GPIO changes, no POWER/REFMUX/INTREF transition, no new physical input, no calibration/rail/cache training. Reuse existing bounded ADS transaction, persistent driver DMA ownership, quarantine termination and full verified restore.
minimal_deferred_candidate.qualification: Each new profile independently permits at most20 rejected CRC packets of800 attempts (2.5%); rejected packets do not count valid/even/odd/raw extrema. Existing status/reset/register/freshness/timeout errors remain hard failures. Keep at least32 accepted even and32 accepted odd CRCs per profile. A failed cadence phase cannot qualify that candidate.
minimal_deferred_candidate.logging: Add explicit cadence field, phase-specific required/attempted/valid/crc/even/odd/reject reason, start/end and unchanged actualSource=idf_khz; do not relabel it runtime accuracy or physical restart proof.
minimal_deferred_candidate.boundedness: Additional1600 attempts per otherwise qualifying candidate; actual elapsed time must be measured. Keep original total deadline, no untested slow fallback and no timeout enlargement. If budget cannot complete, report not qualified.
minimal_deferred_candidate.optional_separate_restart_experiment: Only if restart-phase coverage is specifically required: separate labelled STOP1 -> WREG AA -> START1 -> new DRDY -> RDATA test. This has a datasheet-guaranteed restart but adds commands absent from normal already-running cell switches; do not silently substitute it or claim exact runtime equivalence.

minimum_regression_if_implemented: Assert800 physical AA WREG calls per profile even though the value is unchanged; no other INPMUX/POWER/reference writes.
WREG failure or configuration generation change blocks subsequent sample acceptance.
20/800 CRC boundary passes,21 fails; bad frames never enter parity/raw/cache; timeout/quarantine stop remaining candidates.
Generation baseline captured after WREG; stale notification/low level alone cannot satisfy freshness.
Budget expiry preserves500ms cleanup reservation and firstError/cleanupError separation; verified full physical/driver restore required.
remaining_coverage_limits: AA differential short does not reproduce real VOLT/RES input impedance, amplitude/common-mode, matrix loading or battery/rail helper interference.
The latest runtime improvement cannot be attributed to scheduling, frequency or any single patch without a controlled comparison.
This memo is not an implemented feature, hardware test, new acceptance threshold or permission to alter CRC bits.
